description: Codex diagnoses a flaky test; Claude Code fixes it. Tests a reproduction recipe, a root cause and a commit id.

turns.user: Find why the test suite is flaky. Rule: never mark a failing test as skipped; fix it or tell me.
turns.reply: Understood: no skipped tests. The flaky one is tests/schedule/next-run.test.ts; it fails about 1 run in 6.
Yes: with TZ=Pacific/Auckland and seed 8841 it fails every time.
Root cause: nextRun() builds dates with the local time zone instead of UTC, so it breaks around midnight in UTC+12.
Fixed in commit 9f3c2ab: nextRun() now uses Date.UTC; the test passes 200 of 200 runs under TZ=Pacific/Auckland.
